ITEM 1 | Pale yellow-orange citrus wedge with bright yellow peel edge and translucent segment pattern, slightly glossy, roughly 5 cm long wedge on upper plate area | 25
ITEM 2 | Bright yellow citrus wedge chunk, glossy and moist-looking, rounded edges, about 4 cm across, lying near the center-top of the plate | 20
ITEM 3 | Small yellow-orange citrus piece, smooth skin side visible, slightly translucent, about 3 cm across, next to the wedge above it | 12
ITEM 4 | Bright yellow citrus wedge with a pale pulpy center, about 4 cm across, sitting on top of a small piece of zucchini-like green-skinned vegetable | 18
ITEM 5 | Thick yellow citrus wedge with glossy surface and visible pulp, about 4 cm long, placed center-right beside cauliflower florets | 20
ITEM 6 | Pale yellow-cream cauliflower florets, slightly golden at edges, soft and tender with a bumpy surface, spread across the right-center of the plate, about 8 cm across in a loose cluster | 75
ITEM 7 | Pale cream-colored cauliflower-like florets with a light golden tinge, clustered at the lower-right of the plate, about 7 cm across | 60
ITEM 8 | Pale golden-brown chunk with browned crumbly bits and small dark specks, roughly 4 cm across, sitting at the upper-left of the citrus pieces | 22
ITEM 9 | Green-skinned zucchini-like piece with pale flesh and light browning on one face, about 5 cm long triangular wedge, lying at the left edge of the cluster | 25
ITEM 10 | Small pinkish-red bit visible at the edge of the cauliflower cluster, soft and glossy, about 1.5 cm | 3
ITEM 11 | Small scattered brown crumbly bits, dry and granular, about 1 cm each, dispersed near the top-center of the plate | 3
